scripts.prisma:local:migrate:dev: prisma migrate dev --schema ./src/prisma/local-prisma/schema.prisma && node scripts/local-database-manual-adjustments.js && cp ./src/prisma/local-prisma/migrations/*_init/migration.sql ../scylla-server/migrations/*_create_all/up.sql && cd ../scylla-server && diesel database reset --database-url postgresql://postgres:docker@localhost:5432/charybdis-local && diesel database setup --database-url postgresql://postgres:docker@localhost:5432/charybdis-local && diesel print-schema --database-url postgresql://postgres:docker@localhost:5432/charybdis-local > src/schema.rs
scripts.database:setup: yarn database:setup:script && yarn database:local:setup && yarn database:cloud:setup
scripts.database:local:setup: docker compose up -d charybdis_local && sleep 5 && yarn prisma:local:reset
scripts.database:cloud:setup: docker compose up -d charybdis_cloud && sleep 5 && yarn prisma:cloud:migrate
scripts.database:cloud:teardown: docker compose stop charybdis_cloud && docker-compose rm -f charybdis_cloud
scripts.database:local:teardown: docker compose stop charybdis_local && docker-compose rm -f charybdis_local
